name: Levi Coffin House

location.text: 113 U.S. 27, Fountain City, Wayne County, Indiana

dates.altered: Restored after the state's 1967 purchase 'to appear as it did in the 1840s' (Wikipedia); opened as a historic site in 1970.
dates.note: Wikipedia: 'constructed circa 1838-39 in the Federal style'; the node's exemplar says 1839. The infobox's own style word is Federal, which is where the southern-federal node names it too.

refs.title: Levi Coffin House, Main Cross & Mill Streets, Fountain City, Wayne ...
refs.note: The search result's own line: 'HABS IN-79 National Register of Historic'. The Wikipedia external-links section, read the same day, gives '10 measured drawings' and no data pages; the PDF at the tile.loc.gov data path, fetched the same day, carries only the cover sheet 'REDUCED COPIES OF MEASURED DRAWINGS', so no survey block is recorded.

refs.title: NRHP reference No. 66000009; added October 15, 1966; designated NHL June 23, 1965 (as the Wikipedia infobox prints it)
refs.note: The same number is the NPGallery NHL file id. Read from the infobox, not from the National Register's own database.

note: Ten HABS sheets and no written data: the dimensions of this I-house are on the drawings, which this container cannot open. The southern-federal node names it at the same location string and could join this record. Seeded 4 Sep 2026.
